title: Page 2
content_zh:
童夫人被这变故吓了一跳，不等她说话，童悠悠已经冷冷开口——
“夫人就不想知道刘福他们的下落吗？”
童夫人心头咯噔一下，就是刚缓过劲儿的刘良都忘了爬起来，因为刘福是他的亲弟弟，家里老娘这一阵总在念叨，他当然想知道弟弟的下落。
“当日，刘福到了台州奔丧，说夫人病了，父亲公事繁忙，都不能赶回去。”童悠悠轻蔑的目光扫过童夫人，又道：“后来刘福搬空了家里的库房，偷偷卖了我身边伺候的人，又说父亲重病，催着我早早上路。
“但是到了台州府外一百里的山间，就勾结山贼要杀我灭口，他亲口说是夫人指使的，两个婆子也承认了。
“幸好，我福大命大，被徐家人救下，刘福被恼怒的山贼杀了，但两个婆子却因年迈，不好挪动，所以我就把她们留在一处地方养伤了。”
“什么，刘福死了！”刘良捂着红肿的腮帮子跳了起来。
童夫人却是问道：“两个婆子在哪里？”
童悠悠抬手拿了茶壶倒水，慢悠悠喝了一口，童夫人和刘良不甘心的对视一眼，明白了她的意思。
刘良尚且不甘心，咬着后槽牙威胁道：“刘福当真是被山贼所杀？大小姐可要记清楚了，否则小人去报官，官差传唤大小姐去询问，就不会这么客气了。”
“哦，是吗？官差传唤更好啊，我也问问他们，继妻指使奴仆杀害嫡女是什么罪，就算不是砍头，也会流放三千里吧？徐家大夫人，还有两个婆子，可都是人证。”
童悠悠话音落地，童夫人立刻拦阻道：“不可！一切都是误会。论起辈分来，你即便不愿叫我一声母亲，我总是你的表姨母，我又怎么会害你呢？都是刘福，刘福想要私吞老宅的银钱，怕你回来拆穿，这才起了歹心，同我一点儿干系也没有，以后天长日久相处，你就会明白我的一片真心了。”
“是吗？”童悠悠不置可否，轻轻打了个哈欠，“那夫人让人给我安排住处吧，一路远行，我也实在累了。好好歇歇，说不定我就能想起两个婆子送到了哪里养病，否则，什么时候她们突然回来，到父亲跟前或者到府衙胡说就不好了。”
童夫人死死抠着椅子扶手，这才忍下这口气，“好，你稍等，我这就吩咐奴才们去打扫春晖园，那里是府里最好的院子，你一定会喜欢。”
很快，屋门简单的两个包裹，随着奴仆们离开主院。
刘良几乎是立刻跪倒在童夫人身前，哭道：“夫人，您可要为刘福报仇啊！他死得太冤了。我家老娘最是疼爱刘福，若是知道刘福死了，我娘怕是要活不成了……”
刘良一家子都是童夫人从娘家带来的人，刘婆子更是她的奶娘，提起奶娘的胡搅蛮缠，她也是头疼，赶紧道：“先瞒着，刘福肯定不会白白就这么死了，让这个小贱人先嚣张几日，只要在府里，她一个姑娘家带了个小丫头，想整死她，法子可是多得很。”
刘良还想说什么，童芊芊已经一阵风似的冲了进来，开口就嚷道——
“娘，您怎么让那个小贱人进府了？她不是死了吗，怎么就回来了？我不管，我不让她进府！呜呜呜，您还让她住进春晖园，我要住进去，您都不让！”
童夫人太阳穴突突狂跳，刘良极有眼色的退了出去，并关上门。

第十二章 母女初交手(2)
童夫人一巴掌拍在桌子上，方才强忍着的怒火和怨气顿时爆发了。“没规矩的东西，你跟我喊什么？我说过多少次了，你爹最看重礼数，老夫人过世，就是装，你也装个样子，谁让你穿艳色衣裙出门的，谁让你戴首饰的？丢人现眼的东西，被人家问到我跟前，你知道我多丢脸吗？若是传出你不懂礼数、不敬长辈的名声，看你以后怎么嫁人！”
童芊芊头一次被母亲骂得这么厉害，一时有些害怕，缩手缩脚的站着，泪水含在凤眼里，显得分外可怜。
童夫人心底一动，突然舍不得了，赶紧招手示意闺女上前，抱着她，低声安慰道：“娘是为你好，在家里怎么样都好，但出门一定要装成知书达礼的样子。你爹的官不大，你想要嫁到好人家，就要有个好名声。”
童芊芊腻在母亲怀里，不依不饶的闹着，“娘，我知道您是为我好，那您赶紧把那个小贱人撵出去，我才是童家大小姐，若是被我那帮同窗知道了，还不知道怎么笑话我呢，我以后怎么去上女学？”
童夫人听了越发心疼闺女，想起方才的点滴，更恨童悠悠。“那个小贱人有几分本事，找了徐家撑腰不说，还抓了刘福买通山贼截杀她的把柄，娘一时也不好动她。你先忍耐一段时日，只管好好读书，娘一定想办法早点儿收拾她。”
“当真？”童芊芊也不傻，知道就这么闹下去也不会有结果，索性开始讨价还价，“那娘给我一百两银子，我要买天工楼的龙凤镯子，听说里面可以放东西。我要防身，万一那个小贱人哪日对我不好，我可不能让她欺负我。”
童夫人有些迟疑，“她也不至于敢对你动手……”
“呜呜，娘也不疼我了！”童芊芊立刻抹眼泪，其实她是想买回来，对那几个不顺眼的同窗动手，如今多了一个童悠悠，是更好的借口。
童夫人很快败下阵来，进去内室取了一百两银票给闺女，嘱咐道，“这个月的利钱还没拿回来，我手里就这些余钱了，你可节省着花用。”
“知道了，娘。”童芊芊终于高兴了。
她收了银票，哄着老娘又说起女学里的趣事，倒也哄得童夫人开怀几分。
不说这娘俩如何打算，只说春晖园里，一群婆子丫鬟隐约知道夫人斗败，也不敢怠慢大小姐，拾掇起来还算尽心。
很快，春晖园的三间正房就被打扫出来，特别是内室，还挂了新幔帐，摆了新茶具，备了新被褥。
童悠悠眼见天色太晚，就让虎妞发了赏钱，遣散众人，吩咐她们明日再来继续拾掇。
众人没想到还有赏钱，都很欢喜，赶紧退下。
虎妞肚子饿了，待送了人回来，关门就抱怨，“小姐，那个丑八怪不是吩咐这些人好好伺候您吗，怎么连晚饭都没有？”
童悠悠苦笑，拍拍她的肩膀叹道：“傻丫头，她恨不得杀了我们，就算吩咐了，这些奴仆清楚谁才是主子，怠慢了咱们，他们的主子才高兴，又怎么会当真用心。”
虎妞气得咬牙，“等我找机会，一定把他们打成猪头。”
“好了，”童悠悠劝道，“你去找找，哪里有水，打一些来，咱们洗洗，吃点心垫垫肚子就睡吧。”

“好，我方才看见院角有水井，还有小厨房，明日我做饭给小姐吃。”
虎妞心大，方才还生气，转头就蹦蹦跳跳的出去了。
但她开门还没走两步，却被迎面进来的人惊了一跳，极力压低嗓门，欢喜道：“师傅！”
梁浩海一身黑衣，几乎同夜色融为一体，他手里提了两个纸包，直接扔给虎妞一个，吩咐道：“去守着，我同小姐说会儿话。”
“好。”虎妞鼻子灵，乐滋滋的抱着纸包就跑了，这可是她最爱的烧鸡啊。
content_en:
Mrs. Tong was shocked by this turn of events. Before she could speak, Tong Youyou had already spoken coldly——
"Madam, don't you want to know the whereabouts of Liu Fu and the others?"
Mrs. Tong's heart skipped a beat, and even Liu Liang, who had just recovered, forgot to get up, because Liu Fu was his biological brother, and the mother-in-law at home was always talking about it. Of course he wanted to know the whereabouts of his brother.
"That day, Liu Fu went to Taizhou for a funeral. He said that his wife was sick and that his father was busy with official business and could not rush back." Tong Youyou glanced at Mrs. Tong with contempt and said, "Later, Liu Fu emptied the family warehouse and secretly sold the people who were waiting around me. He also said that my father was seriously ill, so he urged me to leave early.
"But when we arrived in the mountains a hundred miles away from Taizhou Prefecture, he colluded with bandits to kill me. He said personally that it was his wife who ordered him, and the two wives also admitted it.
"Fortunately, I was lucky enough to be saved by the Xu family. Liu Fu was killed by angry bandits, but the two women could not move because of their old age, so I left them in one place to recuperate."
"What, Liu Fu is dead!" Liu Liang jumped up while covering his red and swollen cheeks.
But Madam Tong asked, "Where are the two mothers-in-law?"
Tong Youyou raised her hand to take the teapot and poured water, and took a slow sip. Mrs. Tong and Liu Liang looked at each other unwillingly and understood what she meant.
Liu Liang was not willing to give in. He gritted his molar teeth and threatened: "Liu Fu was really killed by bandits? The eldest lady must remember clearly, otherwise the villain will report to the official and the official will summon the eldest lady to inquire. She will not be so polite."
"Oh, really? It would be better to be summoned by an official. I also want to ask them, what is the crime of the stepwife instructing the slaves to kill the legitimate daughter? Even if it is not beheading, she will be exiled for three thousand miles, right? The eldest wife of the Xu family and the two mothers-in-law are all witnesses."
When Tong Youyou finished speaking, Mrs. Tong immediately stopped her and said, "No! It's all a misunderstanding. In terms of seniority, even if you don't want to call me mother, I am always your cousin, so how could I harm you? It's all Liu Fu. Liu Fu wants to embezzle money from the old house, and he is afraid that you will come back to expose it, so he has evil intentions and has nothing to do with me. If we get along with each other for a long time, you will understand my sincerity."
"Really?" Tong Youyou was noncommittal and yawned lightly, "Then Madam, please ask someone to arrange a place for me. I'm really tired after traveling all the way. Take a good rest, maybe I can remember where the two mothers-in-law were sent to recuperate. Otherwise, it will be bad if they come back suddenly and talk nonsense in front of my father or the government office."
Mrs. Tong dug at the armrest of the chair, and then she could bear her breath and said, "Okay, wait a moment, I will order the slaves to clean Chunhui Garden. It is the best yard in the house. You will definitely like it."
Soon, two simple packages were opened at the door, and the slaves left the main courtyard.
Liu Liang almost immediately knelt down in front of Mrs. Tong and cried: "Madam, you must avenge Liu Fu! He died so unjustly. My mother loves Liu Fu the most. If she knew that Liu Fu was dead, my mother might not be able to survive..."
Liu Liang's family were all brought by Mrs. Tong from her natal family, and Mrs. Liu was her nanny. She also had a headache when she mentioned the nanny's nonsense. She quickly said: "Hide it first, Liu Fu will definitely not die in vain. Let this little bitch be arrogant for a few days. As long as she is in the house, she brings a little girl and wants to torture her to death. There are many ways to kill her."
Liu Liang wanted to say something else, but Tong Qianqian rushed in like a gust of wind and shouted——
"Mom, why did you let that little bitch enter the house? Isn't she dead? Why did she come back? I don't care, I won't let her enter the house! Oh, oh, oh, you let her live in Chunhui Garden. I want to live in it, but you won't let me!"
Mrs. Tong's temples were beating wildly, and Liu Liang withdrew with a wink and closed the door.
Chapter 12 The first encounter between mother and daughter (2)
Madam TongSlapping his palms on the table, the anger and resentment that he had just suppressed suddenly burst out. "What are you yelling at me for being unruly? How many times have I told you that etiquette is the most important thing to your father. When the old lady passes away, just pretend, and you should also pretend. Who asked you to go out in colorful clothes, and who asked you to wear jewelry? Do you know how embarrassed I am when someone asks me about such an embarrassing thing? If there is a reputation that you don't understand etiquette and disrespect your elders, let's see how you get married in the future!"
It was the first time that Tong Qianqian was scolded so severely by her mother. She was a little scared for a moment. She stood shrinking with tears in her eyes, looking extremely pitiful.
Mrs. Tong's heart moved, and she suddenly couldn't bear it. She quickly waved her daughter forward, hugged her, and comforted her in a low voice: "Mom is doing it for your own good. Whatever you do at home is fine, but when you go out, you must pretend to be knowledgeable and courteous. Your father's official position is not high. If you want to marry into a good family, you must have a good reputation."
Tong Qianqian was in her mother's arms, arguing nonchalantly, "Mom, I know you are doing this for my own good, so hurry up and kick that little bitch out. I am the eldest daughter of the Tong family. If my classmates find out and don't know how to laugh at me, how will I go to a girls' school in the future?"
After hearing this, Mrs. Tong felt even more sorry for her daughter. Thinking of what happened just now, she hated Tong Youyou even more. "That little bitch is quite capable. She found support from the Xu family and even caught Liu Fu bribed the bandits to intercept and kill her. Mom can't touch her for a while. You have to be patient for a while and just study hard. Mom will definitely find a way to deal with her soon."
"Seriously?" Tong Qianqian is not stupid. She knew that there would be no results if she continued like this, so she simply started bargaining, "The mother gave me a hundred taels of silver. I want to buy the dragon and phoenix bracelet from Tiangonglou. I heard that you can put things in it. I want to defend myself. If that little bitch treats me badly someday, I can't let her bully me."
Mrs. Tong hesitated, "She wouldn't dare to attack you..."
"Ugh, mother doesn't love me anymore!" Tong Qianqian immediately wiped away her tears. In fact, she wanted to buy it back and do something to those classmates who didn't like it. Now that there is another Tong Youyou, it is a better excuse.
Mrs. Tong was quickly defeated and went into the inner room to take out a hundred taels of silver notes and gave them to her daughter. She said, "I haven't gotten back this month's interest yet. I only have the remaining money in my hand. You can save it for spending."
"I know, mother." Tong Qianqian was finally happy.
She collected the cash check and coaxed her into talking about interesting things in girls' school, which made Mrs. Tong happy.
Not to mention what the two girls planned, I just said that in Chunhui Garden, a group of women and maids vaguely knew that Madam had lost the battle, and they did not dare to neglect the eldest lady, so they were tidying up with all their heart.
Soon, the three main rooms of Chunhui Garden were cleaned out, especially the inner room. New curtains were hung, new tea sets were placed, and new beddings were prepared.
Seeing that it was getting too late, Tong Youyou asked Huniu to pay the reward, dismissed everyone, and told them to come back tomorrow to continue tidying up.
Everyone did not expect that there would be a reward, so they were very happy and quickly left.
Huniu was hungry. When she came back from seeing someone off, she complained after closing the door, "Miss, didn't that ugly guy tell these people to take good care of you? Why didn't he even have dinner?"
Tong Youyou smiled bitterly, patted her shoulder and sighed: "Silly girl, she wants to kill us. Even if she gives orders, these slaves know who their master is. Their master is only happy when they neglect us, so how can they take it seriously?"
Hu Niu gritted her teeth in anger, "When I find a chance, I will beat them into pig heads."
"Okay," Tong Youyou advised, "Go and find water wherever there is. Bring some. Let's wash up, eat some snacks to cushion our stomachs, and then go to bed."
"Okay, I just saw a well in the corner of the courtyard and a small kitchen. I will cook for the lady tomorrow."
Hu Niu was so angry that she turned around and skipped out.
But before she opened the door and took two steps, she was greeted by someone coming in.The person was startled, lowered his voice as hard as he could, and said happily: "Master!"
Liang Haohai was dressed in black, almost blending into the night. He held two paper bags in his hand, threw one directly to Huniu, and said: "Go and guard, I will talk to the lady for a while."
"Okay." Hu Niu had a sharp nose and ran away happily holding the paper bag. This was her favorite roast chicken.
